run_freezing_passes: run freezing_passes on a torch.fx.GraphModule to apply constant folding and binary folding optimizations
register_freezing_graph_pattern: register_freezing_graph_pattern to add a custom graph pattern matching rule to a specified pass
register_binary_folding_pattern: register_binary_folding_pattern to add a custom binary folding pattern matching rule
remove_unnecessary_dtype_convert: remove unnecessary dtype conversion ops from the graph left by Conv-Bn folding
run_addmm_patterns_init: run addmm_patterns_init to initialize matmul and addmm fusion patterns for inductor graph optimization
